name: Your Company
tagline: Uzbekistan’s mountains on foot: from day hikes to a week in the Fann range
niche: Mountain tours and trekking: Chimgan, Beldersay, Fann Mountains, Nuratau

listing.description: A website for a travel agency, guides or an outdoor club. A mountain ridge with altitudes on the first screen, routes as cards with an elevation profile, and the trip itinerary point by point.

seo.title: Your Company — mountain tours and trekking from Tashkent
seo.description: Weekend hikes to Chimgan and Beldersay, multi-day treks in the Fann Mountains and Nuratau. Certified guides, gear rental, transfer from Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company organises mountain hikes from Tashkent. A day hike to Chimgan or Beldersay is from 450,000 sum with transfer and guide, two days with an overnight from 1,200,000 sum, and seven days trekking in the Fann Mountains from 6,900,000 sum. Groups of up to 12, gear available to rent. Office at 16 Shakhrisabz Street.

sections.title: Higher than it looks
sections.subtitle: We take people who have never hiked and people who go every weekend. The route, the guide, the tent and plov at the rest stop are on us; the views are yours.

sections.label: About
sections.title: We hike where we guide
sections.text: Your Company was founded by alpine club instructors in 2015. We walk every route ourselves first, so we know the springs, campsites and fallback descents. Our guides hold instructor certificates and a mountain first-aid course, and every group carries a satellite tracker and a first-aid kit.

items.title: Little Chimgan
items.text: A first mountain outing: a trail through juniper woods to a lookout over the Charvak reservoir.

items.title: Beldersay waterfall
items.text: A gorge, three river crossings and a waterfall. Tulips in spring, red slopes in autumn.

items.title: Big Chimgan
items.text: A climb to the main peak of the Western Tien Shan near Tashkent, with a night in tents.

items.title: Fann Mountains: Seven Lakes and Alauddin
items.text: Turquoise lakes, the Alauddin pass and nights by the water. The drive goes via Samarkand.

items.title: Nuratau: mountains and yurts
items.text: Walks between villages, nights in yurts and guesthouses, and the Sarmishsay petroglyphs.

items.title: Meet at 06:30
items.text: We meet at Buyuk Ipak Yuli metro; the guide checks boots and backpacks.

items.title: Transfer
items.text: Ninety minutes by minibus to the trailhead, with a briefing on the way.

items.title: The climb
items.text: We move at the slowest person’s pace, with a break every 50 minutes.

items.title: Summit and lunch
items.text: Photos, hot tea from a flask and lunch on the stove.

items.title: Descent and home
items.text: You’re back in Tashkent by 19:00, with the photos in the group chat.

items.label: highest point of the Fann Mountains

items.quote: My first time in the mountains at 45. The guide walked beside me the whole climb and never hurried me — I made it to the top of Little Chimgan.
items.author: Gulnora

items.quote: The Fann trip was the best week of the year. Everything was thought through: donkeys, food, a spare day for bad weather.
items.author: Timur

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: Not for easy routes — walking around town is enough. For hard ones we ask you to do a couple of easy hikes first.
Hiking boots, a warm layer, a windbreaker, 1.5 litres of water and a hat. We’ll send the full list after you book.
Yes: tents, sleeping bags, mats, trekking poles and backpacks. Weekend rental from 50,000 sum.
The guide decides. If we cancel, we move the date or give a full refund.
On easy day routes — from age 8 with an adult.

sections.label: Book
sections.title: Heading for the hills?
sections.text: Tell us which route you like and how many of you there are — a guide will reply within an hour with the next group dates.
